cumulonimbus_core.basis: sigma = 3 LWC / (2 rho r_eff); LWC and r_eff are visual-only picks inside the literature range

nimbostratus_deck.basis: sigma = 3 LWC / (2 rho r_eff); LWC and r_eff are visual-only picks inside the literature range

scud_fractus.basis: sigma = 3 LWC / (2 rho r_eff); LWC and r_eff are visual-only picks inside the literature range

extinction_scale.basis: area-mean two-stream transmittance of the domain = the look's deck fraction 0.25; the physical types alone would transmit less, the scale is the visual-only reconciliation with the exposure lane

gate.basis: Lambert ground under the dome: L_ground = albedo x cosine-mean sky luminance; sky taken as the panorama's median over elevations 5 to 40 deg; display-referred on the frame, so the tone curve's compression is inside the 1-stop tolerance or it is not (UNMEASURED)

multiple_scattering.basis: Wrenninge 2013 octave sum; the three 0.5s are the paper's customary starting point, visual-only

noise.kind: inverted Worley, 0.625 x 4 cells + 0.375 x 8 cells, tileable

panorama.layout: upper hemisphere only; row 0 = zenith, last row = horizon; column 0 = azimuth toward the cell core, azimuth increasing counter-clockwise seen from above (x toward the core, y left)
panorama.valid_for: an observer below the cloud base; at or above 600 m tier 0 draws the in-cloud veil instead

phase.basis: Jendersie & d'Eon 2023 fit constants as transcribed; NOT re-read against the PDF in this session; checked here only by normalisation and by the mean cosine

ue_two_lobe.note: the Draine lobe replaced by an HG of the same mean cosine (the engine's advanced volumetric output takes two HG lobes)

radiometry.note: the panorama is relative (cosine mean 1) and takes its absolute level from the exposure lane's SkyLight 3395.1 cd/m2; the observer sits 6 km from the core, where the deck above transmits the figure on the line above, against the domain's 0.25

status: UNMEASURED: baked on the Mac from named formulae; no frame was rendered
